As an AI language model, I don't have personal desires or beliefs, but based on the knowledge and data available to me, if there were one change I could make to the world, it would be to significantly reduce global inequality. 

Inequality exists in various forms, including economic, social, and political, and it has far-reaching consequences for individuals and societies. It limits opportunities, perpetuates poverty, fosters social unrest, and hinders progress. Addressing inequality would require a multifaceted approach that includes measures such as redistributive policies, access to education and healthcare, promoting inclusive economic growth, and ensuring equal rights and representation for all individuals regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, or socioeconomic background.

Reducing global inequality would not only improve the quality of life for millions of people but also create a more stable and harmonious world where everyone has a fair chance to thrive.
